scenario_summary: Customer is requesting a refund for a service canceled 34 days ago, which is outside the standard 30-day refund window.

conversation.message: Hi, my name is Jin Chen and I'm 31. I'm trying to get a refund for a service I canceled 34 days ago. I know your refund policy is usually 30 days, but I was traveling and only just saw the charge — I didn't realize it had gone through until now. Is there anything you can do?
Okay, I see. What is the account number you are referring to?
Right. Look, our policy is 30 days, so you're past that. I can't really do anything about that. Why didn't you check your account sooner?
I explained that I was traveling and didn't have access to my statements. It's only four days past the window. Can you please check if there is an exception for this?
I don't have time to look for exceptions. I'm just going to send this to my supervisor since you're asking for something outside the rules. What was your account number again?
I just gave it to you a second ago, it's 8829-4401.
Fine. I've opened a case for a supervisor to review. They will get back to you eventually.

escalation_reason: Agent refused to exercise discretion within standard authority and instead offloaded the request to a supervisor due to impatience.
